description: Create a secure web or installed-app image picker when the user asks for an upload link, or an image-based action cannot receive the original image directly. Use this even when you can see a chat photo but cannot pass its real file reference, public URL or original bytes to add_wardrobe_item_from_image. For wardrobe photos, use purpose wardrobe_image_add; do not silently switch to add_wardrobe_item_from_description. Generate a requestId for a new action or reuse the same requestId from a direct-image attempt. Currently supports wardrobe_image_add: one clothing item per image. Returns uploadId, uploadPageUrl, expiresAt and a purpose-specific action reference. Show uploadPageUrl and ask the user to open it and submit their photo. Creating the link does not upload the chat attachment or add the item.

menswearOrWomenswear.description: The user's clothing preference. Omit to use their saved preference.

requestId.description: Unique identifier for this requested action. Reuse it for retries and the upload-page fallback; use a new value for another item.

name: create_image_upload
title: Create Image Upload
